subject: Request: Exec concession for Hosted API onboarding — Calyx Analytics
messages:
From: Kim Park <kim@redwood.inference>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@calyx.ai>, procurement@calyx.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Exec concession for Hosted API onboarding — Calyx Analytics

Hi Alicia / Calyx team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited about the pilot. Per our discussion, Calyx is asking for a one-time onboarding credit plus a rate concession on hosted API usage for the first 12 months to help accelerate customer integration and model tuning.

High-level ask:
- 25% unit-rate discount on Hosted API (text generation) for 12 months
- Commitment: 12-month term, estimated 6M tokens/month in months 3-12
- Deliverable: signed MSA + PO and completion of our security questionnaire before go-live

I’m looped in here with Ben to pull together economics and with Markus for legal precedent. Ben — can you confirm expected margin / churn risk if we approve 25% for this ACV profile? I’ve attached the draft SOW and their usage projection.

Thanks,
Kim

--
Kim Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kim@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0126

Attachments: Calyx_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf), Calyx_usage_projection.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)
From: Alicia Park <alicia@calyx.ai>
To: Kim Park <kim@redwood.inference>, procurement@calyx.ai
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Exec concession for Hosted API onboarding — Calyx Analytics

Kim — appreciate the quick follow. A few points from procurement: we need the discount to be 30% for the first 12 months to make the economics work for our pilot stakeholders and procurement will only sign with a fixed unit rate in the SOW. We can commit to a 12-month minimum if Redwood can accept the 30% concession and provide a short-term onboarding credit to offset integration work.

Can you put the exact concession & contract language in writing? Also, please share the DocuSign link when ready. Procurement noted they prefer an invoice cadence of quarterly.

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Head of Partnerships, Calyx Analytics
alicia@calyx.ai

Subject: RE: Request: Exec concession for Hosted API onboarding — Calyx Analytics

Kim / Markus —

Reviewed Calyx’s numbers and the attached projection. Summary: if we approve 30% off hosted unit rates the blended contribution margin falls into a low-single-digit range during ramp but recovers after month 6 assuming usage performs to projection. Key concerns:
- This is a price-sensitive win — high churn risk if we don’t show model quality and rapid integration value.
- Procurement asks (quarterly invoices, fixed unit price) are OK but legal will want firm language around usage overage and termination for non-payment.

Recommendation: escalate for exec signoff with a constrained approval:
- Approve up to 25% discount for Hosted API for 12 months (this is our preferred ceiling for Director-level ok)
- If Sales wants to go to 30%, require Senior Exec (VP/Head level) or CFO sanction and a minimum 12-month prepay or a revenue protection clause (e.g., early termination charge equal to remaining committed volume at list rates)

I attached a quick margin calc and proposed mutual action plan.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference

Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Calyx Analytics Hosted API concession (25%) — conditional

Team —

After reviewing Ben’s margin analysis and the proposed guardrails, I authorize a 25% Hosted API unit-rate concession for Calyx Analytics for the first 12 months under the following conditions:

1) Contract: Signed MSA + SOW must include the exact unit pricing and a clause for early-termination revenue protection (remaining committed tokens billed at list rates).
2) Billing: Require either (a) 12-month prepaid commitment at the discounted rate, or (b) quarterly billing with a 30% advance on the first invoice as security (legal to select).
3) Scope: Discount applies only to Hosted API text-generation endpoints listed in the SOW; embeddings and other products billed at standard rates unless explicitly included.
4) Security: Complete security questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence to be on file prior to production traffic.
5) Executive visibility: Sales must log the final agreement and DocuSign envelope ID in HubSpot; renewals team to review at month 9 for retention risk.

If Sales prefers to offer 30% we need escalation to the CFO for exceptional approval and a mandatory prepay.

Kim — proceed to update the SOW per these terms and circulate the DocuSign link. Mark the HubSpot deal CALX-2029-06 with the DocuSign ID and attach the margin calc.

Thanks,
Mina

--
